analysis: Revenue was $566K in H1 2026, roughly flat year over year.

Gross margin was 35.1%, down 10.0 points from H1 2025. Operating costs exceeded revenue by $194K, an operating margin of -34.3%. Operating expenses fell 13% while revenue changed +0%. The fastest-growing cost line was Sales & marketing (+11%). The period ended with a net loss of $304K.
